hook: Twenty-three classic graphics demos, back in your browser

beats.say: The gallery revives 23 graphics card demos by 3dfx, Nvidia and ATI from 1998 to 2006, all running in the browser.
There is a sea monster with 500 fish that avoid it, a werewolf with eight layers of fur, and a meadow of ten thousand grass blades.
Smoke and water are simulated on the card itself, and you can poke a bubble of springs or pilot a mechanical squid.
